$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the client-side transform catalog. A `transform` step's `fn` must name one of these. Derived artifacts (never hand-edit the list elsewhere): the 'Transform catalog' table in backend/resources/prompts/schema_recipe_dashboard.md is GENERATED from this file (scripts/generate_recipe_schema_doc.py); backend KNOWN_TRANSFORMS is READ from the synced copy at runtime (backend/app/ai/tools/write_recipe.py); and the runtime registry `transformCatalog` in frontend/src/composables/useRecipeTransforms.ts is ASSERTED equal to these names by a unit test. To add a transform: implement it + register it in transformCatalog, then add its row here — that's it.

transforms.name: firstValue
transforms.output: first value of the first row

transforms.name: where
transforms.output: rows matching the predicate (chain firstRow/limit to reduce)

transforms.name: joinBudgetActual
transforms.output: variance rows (flat; remainder mode adds Unbudgeted+Total when `totalAccount` is set)

transforms.name: joinByPeriod
transforms.output: `[{ period, budget, actual, dateFrom, dateTo }]` (`dateFrom`/`dateTo` are the month's calendar bounds — use in a series click link to drill to that period)

transforms.name: joinBudgetActualByPeriod
transforms.output: one row per budgeted `(account, currency, period)` — `{ budget, actual, remaining, pctUsed }`, inclusive-parent; feed `pctUsed` into a `pivot` with `colorByValue` for an accounts×months heat-map

transforms.name: budgetSummary
transforms.output: one aggregate row `{ budget, actual, remaining, pctUsed, pctUsedPct, value }` (maximal-named-subtree, so nested budgets don't double-count) — feeds a ring / KPIs

transforms.name: unbudgetedSpending
transforms.output: actual rows for accounts covered by no budget, sorted desc (inclusive-parent aware) — the 'leak' list; chain `limit` for a top-N

transforms.name: appendTotal
transforms.output: rows (+ optional top-`count`) plus a grand-total row (`isTotal: true`) summing the FULL input, not just the shown rows

transforms.name: groupBy
transforms.output: one row per distinct `key`, each `sum` field totalled exactly (Money), first-seen order — 'totals over time/category'

transforms.name: envelopeRollover
transforms.output: `[{ period, budget, actual, available, carryover, overspent, dateFrom, dateTo }]` — stateless rollover; `reset`+`resetFrom` is the 'start fresh' toggle

transforms.name: envelopeBalances
transforms.output: one row per envelope `{ account, currency, budget, actual, remaining, pctUsed, direction }` — inception-aware running balance; pairs with `budget-progress`

transforms.name: budgetTree
transforms.output: flat `{ account, value }` rows decomposing the total into maximal budgeted children + synthetic `:Unbudgeted` remainder leaves — for a sunburst
